clauses.text:
Executive ®rber
I order to effect the more expeditious reconstruction of the Court House
of the District ,of _____, the early completion of which is necessary so that
the present temporary quarters occupied by the United States Courts and their
officials, uretynee yteWr Department, may be made available for
its use, and by virtue of the provisions of the Act of Congress approved March
4, 1917, entitled "An Act Making Provisions for the Naval Service for the Fiscal
Year Eniding June 30, 1918, and for other Purposes", whereby it is provided
that in case of national emergency the President is authorized to suspend
provisions of law prohibiting more than eight hours labor in any one day by
persons engaged upon work covered by contracts with the United States,
provided further, that the wages of persons employed upon such contracts shall
b)e computed on a basic day rate of eight hours work with overtime rate to be
paid for at not less than time and one-half for all hours work in excess of eight
hours, I (10 hereby suspend the provisions of law prohibiting more than eight
hours of labor in any one (lay by persons engaged in the reconstruction of the
Court House at Washington, D. C. This order shall take effect from and after
this (late.
WOODROW WILSON
Tiiii\TIiIrE IOT SE,
22 A ugust , i1QS.
[No. 2942.]
